data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 26/1153Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: POLO MOVING WEST-NORTHWESTWARD AS AN EXTREMELY DANGEROUS CATEGORY 5 HURRICANE. ...EXPECTED TO MAKE LANDFALL IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR ON MONDAY AS A POWERFUL HURRICANE... As of 5:00 AM MST Sat Sep 26 the center of Polo was located near 17.7, -111.5 with movement WNW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 922 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 160 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Gonzalo (AT2), advisory 26/0847Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: GONZALO STILL A TROPICAL STORM AS IT MOVES AWAY FROM THE CABO VERDE ISLANDS. As of 8:00 AM CVT Sat Sep 26 the center of Gonzalo was located near 17.6, -23.0 with movement N at 9 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1002 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 45 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Odalys (EP1), advisory 26/0838Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: ODALYS BEGINS WEAKENING AS IT CONTINUES TRACKING NORTHWARD. As of 2:00 AM PDT Sat Sep 26 the center of Odalys was located near 19.1, -123.7 with movement N at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 951 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 115 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 26/0838Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY WEAKENS TO A TROPICAL DEPRESSION ONCE AGAIN. As of 9:00 AM GMT Sat Sep 26 the center of Fay was located near 29.7, -43.7 with movement WSW at 3 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1009 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.
